manifest.proposed_manifest:
apiVersion: keda.sh/v1alpha1
kind: ScaledObject
metadata:
  name: documents
  namespace: peakguard-p6
spec:
  scaleTargetRef:
    name: documents
  minReplicaCount: 1
  maxReplicaCount: 4
  triggers:
  - type: cpu
    metricType: Utilization
    metadata:
      value: '70'
  - type: cron
    metadata:
      timezone: Etc/UTC
      start: 35 15 3 11 *
      end: 38 15 3 11 *
      desiredReplicas: '4'
